hook.text: 31 questions to Google yesterday. Not one to Allah.

verses.text: “Call upon Me; I will respond to you.”

end.text: 31 questions to Google yesterday. Not one to Allah.
end.gold: Today, before Dhuhr: raise your hands. Ask Him first.

captions: Your phone keeps the history. Every single one.
How to sleep better. How to stop worrying.
How to fix a friendship. How to feel okay.
Your family talks. You keep scrolling for answers.
Later that night, on the roof, you put the phone away.
You raise your hands. At first, no words come.
Then you tell Him everything. Even the small things.
No answer on a screen. But your heart is quiet.

post.caption:
31 questions to Google yesterday. Not one to Allah. 📱

How to sleep. How to stop worrying. How to feel okay. You searched everywhere — except in front of Him.

“Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” (40:60)

Today, before Dhuhr: raise your hands. Ask Him first. 🤲
